Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax deduction for the sale of certain drugs used to treat cancer.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to business and occupation tax deduction forchemotherapy and anticancer drugs dispensed pursuant to prescription;and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taximposed by RCW 82.04.290(2) amounts received by physicians or clinicsfor chemotherapy and anticancer drugs for infusion or injection bylicensed physicians for human use pursuant to a prescription, but onlyif the amounts are separately stated on invoices or other billingstatements and do not exceed the then current federal rate. Thefederal rate means the rate at or below which the federal government orits agents reimburse providers for prescription drugs administered tocancer patients as provided for in the medicare, part B, drugs averagesales price information resource as published by the United Statesdepartment of health and human services, or any successor index p. 1 HB 1786thereto.
